tipsmod.tip.welcome: MineOctober: Get your pumpkins, pickaxe, and stock up on sweets!
tipsmod.tip.spooky: Ghosts and creepers are afraid of your torch... Hopefully.
tipsmod.tip.pumpkin: A pumpkin on your head won't make you smarter, but it will hide you from Endermen.
tipsmod.tip.candy: Pro tip: Don't eat mysterious candy found in caves. Or do?
tipsmod.tip.night: October nights are long and full of horrors. Don't leave home without a sword.
tipsmod.tip.friend: If a skeleton offers you a bone, it means friendship... or a challenge to a duel.
tipsmod.tip.loot: The best loot is the kind that doesn't bite your head off when you pick it up.
tipsmod.tip.build: Build a cozy cabin with a fireplace. Otherwise, someone (non-player) might move in.
tipsmod.tip.portal: October is the perfect time to clean up the Nether. Or to cause chaos there.
tipsmod.tip.cat: A black cat brings good luck. Or bad luck. Either way, it's cute.
tipsmod.tip.boss: If you hear ominous laughter, run. Or prepare for battle. Your choice.
tipsmod.tip.lore: Ancient inscriptions say: 'He who does not decorate his house will be robbed by zombies.'
tipsmod.tip.treasure: Mysterious chests whisper... Check them for traps before opening!
tipsmod.tip.magic: Enchant everything that moves. Well, your gear too.
tipsmod.tip.rain: October rain is great at masking the sound... of footsteps behind you.
tipsmod.tip.hamster: A cute hamster in your pocket is the best stress relief from creepers.
tipsmod.tip.graves: Graves are the spookiest way to remind you to be more careful.
tipsmod.tip.ghast: Not all ghosts want to set you on fire. Some are just sad.
tipsmod.tip.archeology: When excavating antiquities, be prepared to dig up more than just pots.
tipsmod.tip.foes: This October, some mobs might surprise you with new tactics... or a new face.
tipsmod.tip.critters: Not all creatures are scary. Some just want to make a friend.
tipsmod.tip.ribbit: Frogs in hats. They exist. It's not a fiction.
tipsmod.tip.affinity: October's magic enhances your spells. Or distorts them. Who knows...
tipsmod.tip.creeper_overhaul: If you hear a new hissing sound, it's not a surprise, it's a warning.
tipsmod.tip.grave_loot: Your grave could become the richest stash on the server. Too bad it's not for you.
tipsmod.tip.hamster_friend: A hamster can be cute, but when angry, it's scarier than any zombie. Don't push it.
tipsmod.tip.ancient_danger: Sometimes a brushing brush is needed not for pottery, but for cleaning bones... from flesh.
tipsmod.tip.spooky_companion: Even on the scariest night, it's less lonely with a friend.
tipsmod.tip.illusion: What looks like a cute rabbit might be an Illusioner. Trust, but verify.
